newsitem.title: USA: Minntech pays $4 mln against credit line.
newsitem.headline: Minntech pays $4 mln against credit line.

text.p: Minntech Corp said Tuesday it has paid off the entire $4 million it borrowed against its line of credit last September.

The company said improved cash flow allowed it to pay off $2 million of a $3 million remaining balance on its bank line of credit in the first quarter and to retire $1 million of remaining debt in the second quarter.
Earlier, Minntech reported it earned $1 million, or $0.15 a share for the first quarter ended June 30 compared to $1.3 million, or $0.19 a share, in the same period last year.

"Comparisons of Minntech's first quarter results to the first quarter of last year are difficult due to the significant changes that occurred during the past year," said President and Chief Executive Thomas McGoldrick in a statement.

"We are very encouraged by the tremendous financial progress Minntech has made since our recent restructuring. Earnings have risen from $0.03 per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 (excluding our restructuring charge) to $0.15 at the close of the first quarter," McGoldrick continued.

"We are beginning to see some growth in our gross profit margin, primarily as a result of cost control initiatives instituted at the end of last fiscal year. We have also reduced inventory by $1.7 million,"
